title: [AAPS 3.2.0.3] position of "OK" button in bolus calculator
body:
Here is a comparison of the view in the bolus calculator of AAPS 3.2.0.2 and 3.2.0.3 shown on a small display.

In version 3.2.0.3 I have to scroll down to click the "OK" button.
This feels significantly  less comfortable.
On a larger display, the button in the new position is probably plausible and good.
On a smaller display this leads to problems.

Because I have a small disaplay and I often use the bolus calculator in AAPS: Could you leave the OK button where it was in 3.2.0.2?

Hardware: Google Pixel 4
![AndroidAPS_3 2 0 2_vs_3 2 03](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/16593716/9349dc96-9951-4085-a49c-006ce3260d3c)

comments.body:
I took a closer look at the GUI. Although I was initially unhappy with the change, I have come to the conclusion that the design decision was a good one.
If you have a small display (like me - Pixel 4), deactivate the checkbox next to the eye at the height of the "Cancel" and "OK" buttons. The display is clearer and the buttons are immediately accessible.
I hope that there are not too many people whose display is too small to show the buttons.
@MilosKozak: Well done - thank you!
